name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.82 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
